# CXO Ecosystem Index

Independent structured index maintained by Open Future Forum. Inclusion does not imply endorsement.

Release: v0.9.2
Entity schema: 3.2.0
Last dataset update: 2026-08-11
Release fingerprint: 580ab80ec03b0ed5f636c7df4a671f55c0923a86a38c0fe17f6ab9998b01d134

The Index maps:
- CXO roles and additional executive or investment audiences
- organizations and provider types
- ongoing communities, networks and membership formats
- time-bounded event formats
- research, benchmarks and other intelligence types
- frameworks and decision resources
- executive needs and outcomes
- leadership priorities and topics
- industries and geographies

Classification policy:
- every entity association requires evidence
- missing values remain unknown
- community formats are distinct from event formats
- first-party research is distinct from editorial commentary
- arbitrary role/format/topic combinations remain filters, not indexable pages
